input.quote: 10. NONASSIGNABILITY. Neither party shall assign, transfer, or subcontract this Agreement or any of its obligations hereunder without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: Section 10 imposes a symmetrical consent requirement (not to be unreasonably withheld) but contains no carve-out permitting Company to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets. The fallback position requires a right to assign to successors on written notice, with consent only for other assignments; because every Company assignment — including routine internal reorganizations and M&A — remains subject to Contractor consent, the clause fails the fallback on a material term. There is no change-of-control provision anywhere in the Agreement and no Contractor termination or re-pricing right on our change of control (§ 6 termination rights are mutual and unrelated), so that limb is satisfied; we have added confirming language for certainty. The redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out with notice, bars Contractor assignment to a competitor of ours, and confirms a Company change of control is not a deemed assignment, while leaving the mutual consent standard intact.

proposal.summary: Add Customer affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, no-competitor limit on Contractor assignment, and confirm no Contractor rights on our change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the ability to assign this Agreement to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without Contractor consent, so we have added that carve-out (with notice to Contractor) plus confirmation that a change of control of Company gives Contractor no termination or re-pricing right. We have also confirmed Contractor may not assign to a competitor of ours; the mutual "not unreasonably withheld" consent standard is otherwise unchanged.

ops.oldText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided, however, that Company may assign this Agreement, without Contractor's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, upon written notice to Contractor. Contractor shall not assign or transfer this Agreement to any competitor of Company. No change of control of Company shall be deemed an assignment or give Contractor any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement or any Statement of Work.
